reportExcerpt.themesSummary: Collaboration and on-time delivery: The team highlighted strong collaboration during release week and delivery of the milestone on the planned date. Late-cycle quality and QA exposure: Bugs reaching QA late in the sprint, with suggestion to align test scope with QA before formal testing. Meeting time discipline: Daily sync meetings were reported as often exceeding their scheduled duration. Merge and review standards: Feedback proposed requiring two reviewers on pull requests before merge.
